Fundada em 20 de agosto de 1972, a Unimed do Estado do Rio de Janeiro – Federação Estadual das Cooperativas Médicas (Unimed Ferj) atua há 52 anos como representante estatutária de todas as Unimeds do estado. Ao longo de sua trajetória, a Unimed Ferj tem desempenhado um papel fundamental na promoção da conformidade regulatória e na implementação das melhores práticas de gestão entre as cooperativas do sistema Unimed no Rio de Janeiro.

Com uma governança corporativa voltada para a sustentabilidade e uma cultura organizacional focada em pessoas, a Unimed Ferj é uma referência no Sistema Unimed fluminense, que gera aproximadamente 16 mil empregos diretos e conta com uma ampla rede credenciada. Esses fatores contribuem para que o Sistema Unimed seja reconhecido como referência em Saúde Suplementar no Brasil.

Na função de Operadora de plano de saúde, a Unimed Ferj se dedica a oferecer um atendimento de excelência a mais de 470 mil clientes, por meio de uma ampla rede de médicos cooperados, unidades próprias e serviços credenciados.

Desde abril de 2024, a Unimed Ferj assumiu a gestão, o dimensionamento estrutural e o direcionamento assistencial do Hospital Unimed e dos Prontos Atendimentos Unimed na cidade do Rio de Janeiro. Nas unidades próprias, são mais de 2.400 profissionais comprometidos e dedicados a oferecer um cuidado humanizado e de excelência aos nossos pacientes.

Buscamos pessoas que valorizam as relações humanas e abraçam novas oportunidades. Na Rede Própria da Unimed Ferj, promovemos a diversidade, respeitamos diferentes ideias e perspectivas, e vivemos os princípios do cooperativismo, sempre com foco na excelência do cuidado.

title: Data Strategy & Reporting Manager
description:
Hi there! We are South and our client is looking for a Data Strategy & Reporting Manager!

Note To Applicants

  • Eligibility: This position is open to candidates residing in Latin America.
  • Application Language: Please submit your CV in English. Applications submitted in other languages will not be considered.
  • Professional Presentation: We encourage you to showcase your professional experience by including a Loom video in the application form. While this is optional, candidates who provide a video presentation will be given priority.

Position Summary

The Data Strategy & Reporting Manager will lead the development, governance, and optimization of PHSU’s institutional data ecosystem. This role is responsible for collecting, cleaning, organizing, and integrating data from multiple university systems—including Jenzabar, Salesforce, Anthology, and Element451—into a centralized data warehouse or data lake solution. The position will ensure that data is accurate, accessible, and actionable for strategic, operational, and executive decision‑making across the institution. The ideal candidate blends strong technical skills with an ability to work collaboratively with cross‑functional academic, enrollment, finance, and marketing teams. They will also create a consistent institutional reporting framework, including quarterly strategic updates, monthly performance dashboards, weekly operational metrics, and daily platform‑powered snapshots.

Key Responsibilities

Data Integration & Architecture

  • Assess current data sources and define an end‑to‑end integration strategy.
  • Lead the implementation of a modern data warehouse or data lake solution (Azure, AWS, Snowflake, etc.).
  • Build and maintain data pipelines and ETL/ELT processes.
  • Map data fields across systems and ensure standardized definitions and naming conventions.
  • Integrate new platforms and data sources as the ecosystem evolves.

Data Quality, Governance & Management

  • Clean, transform, and validate datasets.
  • Develop data governance policies, including data definitions, metadata, and stewardship standards.
  • Maintain data dictionaries and internal documentation.
  • Prevent data duplication and integrity issues across platforms.

Cross‑Functional Collaboration

  • Work closely with Enrollment, Academics, Marketing, Finance, IT, and Institutional Research.
  • Lead sessions on data mapping and requirements gathering.
  • Translate business needs into technical specifications and analytics outputs.
  • Provide training on dashboards, metrics, and definitions.

Reporting & Analytics Strategy

  • Build a standardized and scalable reporting ecosystem that includes:
    • Quarterly Strategic Report
    • Monthly Strategic Performance Report
    • Weekly Operational Report
    • Daily Reports
  • Design dashboards, scorecards, and automated reports using BI tools (Power BI, Tableau, Looker, etc.).
  • Ensure real‑time visibility into KPIs and trends for leadership and teams.

Performance, Insights & Optimization

  • Build forecasting models and goal‑tracking frameworks.
  • Partner with Marketing to centralize investment, campaign, and channel‑performance data.
  • Continuously optimize data pipelines and integrations for speed and reliability.

Key Competencies

  • Strategic thinking
  • Attention to detail
  • Problem‑solving
  • Technical expertise
  • Cross‑functional communication
  • Project management
  • Data visualization and storytelling
  • Accountability and follow‑through

  • Excellent attention to visual detail, consistency, and brand cohesion.
  • Strong communication skills and ability to work cross‑functionally.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Familiarity with Amazon creative formats (main image, A+ content, carousel, Sponsored Brand, and Storefront).

  • Understanding of eCommerce CRO principles (CTR, CVR, and visual hierarchy).
  • Basic familiarity with data‑driven creative testing and split testing.

What You’ll Gain

  • Experience collaborating across design, analytics, and marketing teams.

At Mindrift, innovation meets opportunity. We believe in using the power of collective human intelligence to ethically shape the future of AI.

What We Do

The Mindrift platform, launched and powered by Toloka, connects domain experts with cutting‑edge AI projects from innovative tech clients. Our mission is to unlock the potential of GenAI by tapping into real-world expertise from across the globe.

Who we’re looking for

We’re looking for curious and intellectually proactive contributors, the kind of person who double‑checks assumptions and plays devil’s advocate. Are you comfortable with ambiguity and complexity? Does an async, remote, flexible opportunity sound exciting? Would you like to learn how modern AI systems are tested and evaluated?

Type of role

This is a flexible, project-based opportunity well‑suited for:

  • Analysts, researchers, or consultants with strong critical‑thinking skills
  • Students (senior undergrads / grad students) looking for an intellectually interesting gig
  • People open to a part‑time and non‑permanent opportunity

About the project

We’re on the hunt for QAs for autonomous AI agents for a new project focused on validating and improving complex task structures, policy logic, and agent evaluation frameworks. Throughout the project, you’ll have to balance quality assurance, research, and logical problem‑solving. This project opportunity is ideal for people who enjoy looking at systems holistically and thinking through scenarios, implications, and edge cases. You do not need a coding background, but you must be curious, intellectually rigorous, and capable of evaluating the soundness and consistency of complex setups.

What you’ll be doing

  • Reviewing evaluation tasks and scenarios for logic, completeness, and realism
  • Identifying inconsistencies, missing assumptions, or unclear decision points
  • Helping define clear expected behaviours (gold standards) for AI agents
  • Annotating cause‑effect relationships, reasoning paths, and plausible alternatives
  • Thinking through complex systems and policies as a human would to ensure agents are tested properly
  • Working closely with QA, writers, or developers to suggest refinements or edge case coverage

How to get started

Apply to this post, qualify, and get the chance to contribute to a project aligned with your skills, on your own schedule. Shape the future of AI while building tools that benefit everyone.

Requirements

  • Excellent analytical thinking: can reason about complex systems, scenarios, and logical implications
  • Strong attention to detail: can spot contradictions, ambiguities, and vague requirements
  • Familiarity with structured data formats: can read, not necessarily write JSON/YAML
  • Ability to assess scenarios holistically: what’s missing, what’s unrealistic, what might break?
  • Good communication and clear writing (in English) to document your findings.

We also value applicants who have

  • Experience with policy evaluation, logic puzzles, case studies, or structured scenario design
  • Background in consulting, academia, olympiads (e.g. logic/math/informatics), or research
  • Exposure to LLMs, prompt engineering, or AI‑generated content
  • Familiarity with QA or test‑case thinking (edge cases, failure modes, “what could go wrong”)
  • Some understanding of how scoring or evaluation works in agent testing (precision, coverage, etc.)

Benefits

  • Get paid for your expertise, with rates that can go up to $17/hour depending on your skills, experience, and project needs
  • Take part in a flexible, remote, freelance project that fits around your primary professional or academic commitments
  • Participate in an advanced AI project and gain valuable experience to enhance your portfolio
  • Influence how future AI models understand and communicate in your field of expertise

Fundada em 20 de agosto de 1972, a Unimed do Estado do Rio de Janeiro – Federação Estadual das Cooperativas Médicas (Unimed Ferj) atua há 52 anos como representante estatutária de todas as Unimeds do estado. Ao longo de sua trajetória, a Unimed Ferj tem desempenhado um papel fundamental na promoção da conformidade regulatória e na implementação das melhores práticas de gestão entre as cooperativas do sistema Unimed no Rio de Janeiro.

Com uma governança corporativa voltada para a sustentabilidade e uma cultura organizacional focada em pessoas, a Unimed Ferj é uma referência no Sistema Unimed fluminense, que gera aproximadamente 16 mil empregos diretos e conta com uma ampla rede credenciada. What We Do

The Mindrift platform, launched and powered by Toloka, connects domain experts with cutting‑edge AI projects from innovative tech clients. Our mission is to unlock the potential of GenAI by tapping into real‑world expertise from across the globe.

About The Role

We’re looking for someone who can design realistic and structured evaluation scenarios for LLM‑based agents. You’ll create test cases that simulate human‑performed tasks and define gold‑standard behavior to compare agent actions against. You’ll work to ensure each scenario is clearly defined, well‑scored, and easy to execute and reuse. You’ll need a sharp analytical mindset, attention to detail, and an interest in how AI agents make decisions.

Although every project is unique, you might typically:

  • Design structured test scenarios based on real‑world tasks
  • Define the golden path and acceptable agent behavior
  • Annotate task steps, expected outputs, and edge cases
  • Work with devs to test your scenarios and improve clarity
  • Review agent outputs and adapt tests accordingly

How To Get Started

Simply apply to this post, qualify, and get the chance to contribute to projects aligned with your skills, on your own schedule. From creating training prompts to refining model responses, you’ll help shape the future of AI while ensuring technology benefits everyone.

Requirements

  • Bachelor’s and/or Master’s Degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Data Science or Analytics, Artificial Intelligence / Machine Learning, Computational Linguistics / NLP, Information Systems or other related fields
  • Background in QA, software testing, data analysis, or NLP annotation
  • Good understanding of test design principles (e.g., reproducibility, coverage, edge cases)
  • Strong written communication skills in English
  • Comfortable with structured formats like JSON/YAML for scenario description
  • Can define expected agent behaviors (gold paths) and scoring logic
  • Basic experience with Python and JS
  • Curious and open to working with AI‑generated content, agent logs, and prompt‑based behavior
  • Ready to learn new methods, able to switch between tasks and topics quickly and sometimes work with challenging, complex guidelines
  • Freelance role is fully remote; you just need a laptop, internet connection, time available, and enthusiasm to take on a challenge

Nice to Have

  • Experience in writing manual or automated test cases
  • Familiarity with LLM capabilities and typical failure modes
  • Understanding of scoring metrics (precision, recall, coverage, reward functions)

Benefits

Contribute on your own schedule, from anywhere in the world. This opportunity allows you to:

  • Take part in a flexible, remote, freelance project that fits around your primary professional or academic commitments

Descrição da vaga

Prazer, Grupo SBF. Para nós, esporte é mais que só a prática: é movimento. Ele tem o poder de mover as pessoas pelo exercício, pela paixão pelo time do coração, pela diversão de uma aula de dança, pela força de marcas icônicas. Por vermos a potência do esporte em todas as suas expressões, trabalhamos juntos com garra e energia para construir o primeiro ecossistema de esporte do mundo, reunindo diversas possibilidades para que as pessoas sejam envolvidas e impactadas pelo poder de se movimentar. Quando você pensar em esporte, pode ter certeza: o Grupo SBF estará ali. Seja por meio das lojas e do e-commerce da Centauro, a maior varejista esportiva multimarcas da América Latina; da Fisia, distribuidora oficial da Nike no Brasil; da FitDance e da OneFan, aqui o movimento não para. Praticante ou entusiasta, fã ou apaixonado, o Grupo SBF é pra você. Somos saudavelmente inconformados, fazedores e convictos da importância de levar o movimento para cada vez mais gente.

Responsabilidades e atribuições

  • Gerenciar e dar suporte à infraestrutura tecnológica das lojas (servidores de loja, estações de PDV, impressoras fiscais/não fiscais, leitores de código de barras e pin pads).

  • Coordenar a manutenção corretiva e preventiva de equipamentos de TI nas unidades, interagindo com fornecedores e técnicos de campo.
  • Realizar configurações e atualizações de firmware e software específicos do ambiente de loja.
  • Administrar a rede local (LAN) das lojas, incluindo switches, access points Wi‑Fi e links de comunicação (WAN).
  • Monitorar e otimizar a conectividade entre a loja e o Datacenter/Cloud, assegurando a estabilidade da transmissão de dados de vendas (vendas, estoque, transações).

  • Desenvolver e manter a documentação dos ambientes de loja (diagramas de rede, manuais de configuração de PDV e procedimentos de troubleshooting).

Ao longo de sua trajetória, a Unimed Ferj tem desempenhado um papel fundamental na promoção da conformidade regulatória e na implementação das melhores práticas de gestão entre as cooperativas do sistema Unimed no Rio de Janeiro.

Na função de Operadora de plano de saúde, a Unimed Ferj se dedica a oferecer um atendimento de excelência a mais de 470 mil clientes, por meio de uma ampla rede de médicos cooperados, unidades próprias e serviços credenciados.

Nas unidades próprias, são mais de 2.400 profissionais comprometidos e dedicados a oferecer um cuidado humanizado e de excelência aos nossos pacientes.

Job description

Desde dezembro de 2015, a SPDM/PAIS é responsável, em parceria com a Secretaria Municipal de Saúde do Rio de Janeiro, pelo gerenciamento do Hospital Municipal Pedro II .

A infraestrutura do Hospital conta com dez andares, nos quais estão distribuídos os serviços de emergência e de Unidade de Tratamento Intensivo (UTI) adulta, pediátrica e neonatal; maternidade; clínica médica, cirurgia-geral e bucomaxilofacial, neurocirurgia, psiquiatria, pediatria e ortopedia. Exames de imagem (raio X, tomografia, ultrassonografia, eletrocardiografia, ecocardiografia) e laboratoriais também são realizados na unidade.

Devido à grande população de idosos da Zona Oeste, região assistida pelo Hospital Municipal Pedro II (HMPII), há duas Enfermarias destinadas ao atendimento desse público.

O Centro de Tratamento de Queimados é outro diferencial entre os serviços oferecidos, e que dispõe de uma UTI exclusiva para prevenir infecções, que podem ser muito graves para quem está com queimaduras.

Além disso, a unidade conta com a Coordenação de Emergência Regional (CER) Santa Cruz, que possui 39 leitos, e tem como objetivo absorver as demandas de menor complexidade, deixando o HMPII liberado para os casos de risco iminente de morte, necessidade de cirurgia urgente e/ou internação. Um diferencial deste CER é o fato de possuir atendimento especializado em Psiquiatria e Obstetrícia.

Um aeroporto com a alma carioca! O RIOgaleão é o maior equipamento urbano do Rio de Janeiro, com grande importância para a economia do estado. Ao longo de 11 anos de operação, recebemos mais de 100 milhões de passageiros, fomos o aeroporto Olímpico, vimos a cura da Covid chegar pelo nosso Terminal de Cargas e somos a porta de entrada para os principais eventos da cidade.

Nosso Jeito RIOgaleão de Ser abraça a diversidade, por isso, nossos processos seletivos são abertos a todos, afinal trabalhamos todos os dias para a verdadeira conexão.

We are looking for the right people — people who want to innovate, achieve, grow and lead. We attract and retain the best talent by investing in our employees and empowering them to develop themselves and their careers. Experience the challenges, rewards and opportunity of working for one of the world’s largest providers of products and services to the global energy industry.

Job Duties

You’ll own the delivery lifecycle end-to-end — from architecture and design to production reliability, technical mentorship, and stakeholder alignment. We’re looking for someone who can turn complex requirements into secure, scalable, high-quality software — and help the team grow in the process.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Own architecture and design: create system diagrams, define functional and non-functional requirements (such as scalability, reliability, security and cost), and set integration standards.
  • Build and deliver using our technology stack (see below) with focus on quality, performance, and observability.
  • Lead initiatives: break down roadmaps, manage small to medium-sized projects, remove blockers, and ensure on-time delivery.
  • Plan and prioritize: create execution plans, estimate effort, manage risks, and clearly communicate progress to stakeholders.
  • Drive engineering excellence: enforce automated testing (unit, integration, e2e), deep code reviews, branch and release standards, and code quality.
  • Document for scale: maintain architecture documents, ADRs, operational guides, and runbooks, ensuring traceability and clarity within agile processes and tools.
  • Client interaction: attend remote and in-person meetings, capture requirements, discuss trade-offs, and present solutions clearly.
  • Mentor others: guide mid-level and junior developers, share best practices, lead tech talks, and promote a learning culture.
  • Partner management: coordinate third parties, validate deliverables, and ensure alignment with project goals.
  • Ensure production quality: validate system integrations, instrument logs, metrics, and tracing, define basic SLOs, and participate in post-mortems.
  • Continuous learning: explore new technologies, identify process improvements, and propose architectural enhancements.
  • Administrative support: handle operational requests and be available for national or international travel when required.

Qualifications

  • Education: Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology or related field.
  • Experience: 7+ years of professional experience, including technical leadership on complex projects.
  • Stack: Backend (Java, Python and .Net Core), Frontend (Angular), Node.js, SQL, strong background in REST API development, microservices and event-driven architectures.
  • Cloud: Hands-on experience with AWS or Azure, IAM (Identity and Access Management), storage, managed services and observability.
  • Quality & DevOps: Test automation, Git, Gitflow, CI/CD pipelines, Docker, Kubernetes, semantic versioning and promotion across environments.
  • Security & Reliability: Familiarity with OWASP Top 10, secret management, least privilege, basic hardening, and observability (logs, metrics, tracing).
  • Language: Advanced English (written and spoken, client-facing).
  • Profile: Proactive, system thinker, fluent with modern frameworks and best practices in development, testing, and cloud operations.

Nice to have:

  • Postgraduate or Master’s degree.
  • IaC (Terraform) and platform engineering principles.
  • Multi-cloud experience (AWS/Azure/GCP) and cost/performance optimization.
  • Exposure to performance tuning, caching, messaging/queue systems (e.g., Kafka), and feature flag management.

title: Líder De Operações Logísticas, Amxl Amazon Logistics
description:
Nossas equipes de logística estão mudando a maneira como interagimos com clientes em todo o mundo todos os dias e resolvendo alguns dos maiores desafios logísticos enfrentados não apenas pela Amazon, mas também por toda a indústria. Sejam itens grandes ou pequenos, encontramos soluções para garantir que estamos cumprindo nossa promessa para os clientes.

A equipe da Amazon Logistics Brasil (AMZL) está procurando uma pessoa Líder de Operações Logísticas para se juntar ao time de transportes, especificamente para a operação AMXL (Amazon Extra Large) - nossa operação dedicada para produtos grandes e pesados. Esta é uma operação estratégica focada em itens Big Non-Sort e Heavy and Bulk, que demandam processos logísticos especializados e diferenciados.

As operações serão feitas 7 dias por semana, incluindo feriados; portanto, trabalhar em diferentes turnos será parte dessa função.

Você atuará na gestão de uma equipe de parceiros logísticos externos especializados em produtos grandes e pesados, como também gerenciará uma equipe de analistas de operações logísticas, que também serão funcionários Amazon, para garantir o desempenho e conformidade dos processos desses parceiros. Trabalhará em um ambiente altamente colaborativo que é mais próximo de uma start-up do que uma grande empresa. A atitude adotada é que nenhuma ideia é uma má ideia e as melhores ideias são aquelas que devem ser testadas e experimentadas.

Key job responsibilities

Fazer a gestão do time de Analistas de Operações Logísticas, garantindo o desenvolvimento e performance da equipe em um ambiente de operação especializada em produtos grandes e pesados (AMXL)

Atuar como ponto focal de relacionamento e acompanhamento de métricas dos parceiros logísticos especializados em AMXL, responsáveis pelas estações de entregas

Acompanhar e garantir a execução dos treinamentos específicos para manuseio de produtos grandes e pesados, além de projetos de melhoria contínua dos parceiros logísticos AMXL

Criar, acompanhar e analisar métricas operacionais e financeiras específicas da operação AMXL com os parceiros logísticos, incluindo indicadores de capacidade, utilização de frota especializada, e performance de entrega

Analisar dados de várias fontes, identificar tendências relevantes para que, a partir deles, decisões rápidas e importantes ao negócio sejam tomadas

Encontrar soluções práticas e simples para problemas complexos relacionados à logística de produtos grandes e pesados, considerando as particularidades de manuseio, transporte e entrega

Servir de elo entre os stakeholders internos e externos relacionadas às operações AMXL

Mergulhar profundamente nas causas raízes dos problemas operacionais específicos da operação AMXL, propondo e implementando soluções escaláveis

Apoiar os lançamentos de novos parceiros logísticos especializados em AMXL, garantindo a correta implementação de processos e padrões de qualidade

A day in the life

Como Líder de Operações Logísticas AMXL, você será o ponto central entre a Amazon e nossos parceiros logísticos. Seu dia começará revisando métricas operacionais - volumes entregues, performance de entrega (OTD), incidentes de manuseio, e utilização de capacidade da frota AMXL.

Você trabalhará com stakeholders internos e gerenciará sua equipe de Analistas de Operações Logísticas. Com os parceiros logísticos externos, conduzirá reuniões operacionais revisando KPIs como FTDS, DEA, e custos operacionais, identificando gaps e implementando melhorias de processo.

Você também será fundamental no onboarding de novos parceiros AMXL.

About the team

O time de AMXL Brasil faz parte da Amazon Logistics e é responsável por revolucionar a entregas no país. Somos uma equipe altamente colaborativa, orientada por dados e focada em inovação, onde testamos novas ideias constantemente e valorizamos a autonomia e o senso de dono. Trabalhamos em um ambiente dinâmico similar a uma start-up, onde cada membro tem voz ativa e contribui diretamente para melhorar a experiência do cliente final. Country Finance Manager - Brazil & Argentina join to apply for the Country Finance Manager - Brazil & Argentina role at Accelleron. Accelleron is accelerating sustainability in the marine and energy industries as a global technology leader in turbocharging, fuel injection, and digital solutions for heavy‑duty applications.

Building on a heritage of over 100 years as a trusted industry partner, the company serves customers in more than 100 locations in over 50 countries.

Accelleron's 3,000 employees are continuously innovating to deliver best‑in‑class products, services, and solutions that are mission‑critical for the energy transition.

You will join a team of experts in an exciting international environment, committed to excellence and innovation.

Together, we support our customers in driving the transition toward sustainable industries with cutting‑edge technology, deep expertise, and smart solutions.

At Accelleron, we foster diversity and inclusion, welcoming and celebrating individual differences as a source of strength.

Job Description

As the key financial leader for Area Brazil and Argentina, you will act as copilot of the Country Managing Director (CMD) and be responsible for all local finance and commercial management matters. Partnering closely with the CMD, you will play a critical role in steering the direction and success of the organization by providing timely and accurate financial insights and demonstrating strong business acumen. You will lead and oversee all aspects of controlling, accounting, reporting, internal control, commercial management, fiduciary responsibilities, treasury, and tax matters to sustainably optimize business performance and financial position. Representing the company externally, you will ensure full compliance with all legal requirements and internal policies. The Country Finance Manager (CFM) reports to the Global Division Controller & Commercial Manager Service and the Country Managing Director.

Your Responsibilities

Strategic Leadership : Contribute to the local implementation of the Accelleron business strategy, providing strategic financial leadership and direction.

Business Planning : Develop and translate strategy into comprehensive business plans (budget / forecast), set measurable targets, and coordinate / oversee the corresponding processes. Assess financial implications of strategic decisions, create, and evaluate business scenarios, and initiate corrective actions when necessary.

Performance Management and decision support : Monitor financial performance across multiple dimensions, delivering insights to support both operational and strategic decision‑making. Drive cost structure optimization, productivity improvements, and capital efficiency to maximize value creation.

Commercial and Risk Management : Identify and communicate commercial and financial risks and opportunities arising from business propositions, such as contracts. Conduct risk and contract reviews in line with global policies and standards to minimize risks and exposure. Monitor overdue accounts to mitigate default risk and safeguard company assets.

Financial Reporting : Establish and oversee processes and tools to ensure transparent and reliable financial data, reported in compliance with Group standards (US‑GAAP) and financial closing schedules.

Accounting and Statutory Reporting : Ensure accurate financial bookkeeping (via our external Accounting Service Provider) in accordance with local accounting principles. Ensure timely preparation of accurate statutory financial statements.

Tax Compliance : Responsible for the preparation and filing of accurate tax returns (including timely payment) for corporate income taxes, transfer pricing and indirect taxes, in collaboration with your tax service provider. Ensure adherence to Accelleron tax policies as well as local and international tax regulations to ensure full tax compliance. Monitor changes in local tax legislation and assess their impact with local and global experts.

Governance, Compliance, and Audits : Establish and maintain local governance in line with corporate standards, regulations, policies, and legal requirements. Ensure effective execution of internal controls for financial and specified non‑financial operations. Coordinate external audits and support internal audits, acting as a liaison with the global legal and integrity function.

Act as Secretary to the Board of Directors. Ensure regulatory filings, reporting, and other general affairs tasks.

Treasury Management : Secure, plan and manage the company's liquidity, including investment and debt management. Responsible for the local bank relationships, including the management of bank accounts, bank guarantees and other local banking services. Identify and manage foreign exchange risks, implementing hedging strategies in accordance with Group policies. Oversee the company's local insurance policies and credit risk management in alignment with Group guidelines.

Your Background

University degree in Finance / Controlling or Chartered Financial Accountant (e.g., ACCA, ACA, ICAEW, ICAS, CPA, CIMA) or extensive practical work experience with demonstrated achievements.

Up‑to‑date knowledge of local statutory accounting principles (BR GAAP, ARG GAAP) and US‑GAAP / IFRS, combined with practical application experience.

Demonstrated experience in tax compliance, specifically in preparing and filing corporate income tax returns, managing transfer pricing, and handling indirect taxes.

Strong financial background with a structured and results‑oriented approach and exceptional analytical skills.

High IT proficiency with experience in SAP (S4Hana is a strong advantage) and Microsoft Office products.

Proven team player with strong problem‑solving skills, an open‑minded approach to challenges, and the persistence to deliver on time.

Ability to manage multiple priorities simultaneously, ideally with corresponding work experience from within a matrix organization.

7+ years of experience in a controlling / accounting role within an international environment, preferably with an industrial background.

Demonstrated leadership skills with a commitment to coaching and developing team members to reach their professional goals.

Fluency in English and Portuguese is a must, while proficiency in Spanish is a strong advantage.

Your Benefits

Competitive compensation package

International development opportunities

Modern office environment with flexible working arrangements

Lunch allowances

Insurance policy

Employee Assistance program

We’re a remote-first team of ambitious, creative collaborators focused on delivering exceptional digital experiences for the world’s most forward-thinking brands.

We’re building our pipeline of vetted creative partners for near‑term and future collaborations. This role is ideal for designers interested in working with BX Studio on an ad hoc project basis as opportunities align.

We’re looking for a Graphic & Motion Designer to help bring SaaS and digital‑first brands to life through compelling visual and motion storytelling. You’ll collaborate with senior designers and art directors to design product‑driven graphics, animations, and illustrative elements that enhance websites, pitch materials, and brand systems.

Design and animate graphics for SaaS interfaces, abstractions, data visualizations, and infographics that communicate product stories with clarity and impact.

Develop brand‑aligned illustrations and visual systems that extend client assets across digital experiences.

Design brand and sales collateral including pitch decks, social graphics, reports, and client‑facing documents for both digital and print applications.

Storyboard and concept short animations that demonstrate product value or explain key interactions.

Collaborate with UX, web, and motion leads to ensure visual consistency and seamless integration across site designs.

Support design and production of brand collateral, pitch decks, social graphics, and internal marketing materials.

Translate feedback from senior designers and clients into clear creative refinements.

Stay current on visual, animation, and data‑driven design trends, bringing fresh ideas to the team.

What We’re Looking For

2–4 years of experience in graphic or motion design , ideally within an agency or digital‑product setting.

Strong portfolio showcasing UI abstractions, product graphics, data visualization, and motion design.

Experience working with B2B or SaaS brands a plus.

Proficiency in Figma, After Effects, Illustrator, and Photoshop (bonus : InDesign, PowerPoint, or light 3D).

Strong sense of composition, hierarchy, and animation timing.

Comfortable following established brand systems while contributing original ideas.

Organized, detail‑oriented, and reliable in meeting deadlines across multiple projects.

Enthusiasm for collaboration and openness to feedback from senior team members.

Why Join BX Studio?

Collaborate with award‑winning designers and developers on world‑class Webflow and brand projects.

Shape high‑impact visual storytelling for leading B2B and consumer technology brands.

Join a remote‑first, high‑performing team that values craft, clarity, and creative rigor.

Contribute to an agency recognized as the 2025 Webflow Enterprise Partner of the Year, helping define the next evolution of web design.

Job description

A Aegea

Criada em 2010, a Aegea é líder no setor privado de saneamento básico no Brasil. Em cada município onde atua, leva mais saúde e qualidade de vida para a população, respeitando sempre o meio ambiente e a cultura local.

A Concessionária

A Águas do Rio, concessionária da Aegea é responsável pelo abastecimento de água e esgotamento sanitário em 27 municípios do estado do Rio de Janeiro, incluindo 124 bairros da capital, atendendo 10 milhões de pessoas.

Durante o período de concessão, iniciado em 1º de novembro de 2021, a companhia realizou o maior investimento em saneamento básico no país, em torno de R$ 39 bilhões. R$ 15,4 bilhões em outorga, para serem aplicados em projetos prioritários dos governos estadual e municipais, e R$ 24,4 bilhões para a universalização dos serviços de água e esgoto, que será alcançada nos primeiros 12 anos, em alinhamento ao novo Marco Regulatório de Saneamento.

Programa Respeito dá o Tom

O programa nasceu com a meta de espelhar a demografia da população brasileira no quadro de funcionários da empresa.

Em 2022 a Aegea emitiu um título sustentável atrelado a metas que incluem alcançar 45% de mulheres e 27% de negros em cargos de liderança até 2030, sendo pioneira em se comprometer com meta de diversidade racial em cargos de liderança.

A Aegea tem o compromisso com apromoção de um ambiente de trabalho mais igualitário, diverso e inclusivo, e estimula o respeito e a valorização das diferenças.

title: Senior Social Content Producer
description:
Up to BRL 220,000 per year (depending on experience) on a full time, contractor contract Fully remote working anywhere in Brazil!

Work with the latest high-end hardware and creative software.

You’ll develop your AI edge — we’ll help you use and deepen your skills with AI tools so you stay ahead of the curve, not left behind by how the industry is changing.

A culture where ideas matter — your suggestions shape how we work.

⚡ Fast, flexible, and innovative — we move like a start-up with the backing of a global team.

Be part of a global team of 200+ talented colleagues.

Working hours : 9am – 5 : 30pm Pacific Time Zone, with a 1 hr lunch break

Role Snapshot

A multi-skilled, hands-on role leading the creative output as a versatile, social-first storyteller and writer.

You’ll be the creative engine on one high-profile entertainment account, spotting trends, pitching ideas, and turning TV and film moments into scroll-stopping social content. You’ll lead a small team as the day-to-day creative and production lead under the Account Manager, taking ideas from spark to post, managing (and partaking in) ideation, production workflows, copy, and owning the quality of what your team ships.

It’s a genuinely fast-paced agency environment with shifting priorities and tight deadlines, so you’ll need to enjoy that bit of pressure and stay calm and organized when things move quickly. You’ll also use AI in smart, safe ways to boost creativity and efficiency, keeping you ahead of the curve in this changing industry.

If you’re chronically online, obsessed with media and fandoms, love collaborating with others and excited to build upon your AI skills, we want to hear from you.

Who You Are

  • ✅ Culture-obsessed creative & Social-native storyteller : Chronically online, plugged into fandoms, memes and platform trends, and excited to turn them into smart ideas for TV and film IP. You think in hooks, formats and series, and understand how stories travel across different platforms.
  • ✅ Resilient under pressure with high agency : You thrive in a fast-moving environment with shifting priorities and tight deadlines. You spot problems and opportunities and take ownership to fix or pursue them without waiting to be asked.
  • ✅ Clear, confident communicator : Able to pitch ideas, give feedback and handle client comments calmly, clearly and constructively.
  • ✅ Team lead, accountable for output : You’re comfortable setting direction for a small team, giving clear feedback, and taking responsibility for the quality and timeliness of everything your team ships, not just your own tasks.
  • ✅ Organised producer : Strong on deadlines, details and juggling multiple titles at once, while keeping tools, calendars and asset libraries accurate.
  • ✅ AI-fluent creator : You already use AI tools and LLMs to boost your creativity and speed, and you’re curious about weaving them into everyday workflows.
  • ✅ Driven by doing great work : Energized by smart, well-crafted content, proud of the output, and focused on delivering for both clients and fans.

Not required but nice to haves

  • Experience in social-first production — creating or producing content specifically for social channels.
  • Copywriting Experience — writing creatively for any platform that showcases a strong tone of voice.
  • Entertainment or fandom experience — working on film / TV, streaming, gaming or other fandom-heavy brands.
  • Hands-on creative skills — basic design, editing or motion skills

Who We Are

At Storm Ideas, we supercharge the digital presence of some of the biggest names in US TV and entertainment. Since 2008, our international team has delivered bold, forward-thinking solutions for globally recognised clients.

Whether we're building innovative products, producing high-impact social content, or designing smarter ways for our partners to work—we’re right at the cutting edge of creativity, technology, and automation.

Embracing Future-Facing Technology

Emerging technologies like Artificial Intelligence present exciting opportunities for us and our clients. As the world adapts, we’re committed to safely exploring the potential advantages of AI, integrating it thoughtfully into our work where possible, and one day guiding our clients through new possibilities when they’re open and ready for them. By tapping into our creativity, expertise, and collaboration, we aim to embrace its potential together. Our vision relies on people who are curious about this technology and excited to take on this challenge!

What You’ll Make Happen

Lead the day-to-day production workflow, turning brand priorities, fandom insights and social trends into clear, platform-native and reactive content ideas across platforms.

Describe concepts in detail and turn approved ideas into thorough, practical briefs for editors, motion graphic artists and designers, including references, formats, specs and deliverable lists.

Own the production pipeline : download and organize footage and other assets, assign tasks, track progress, remove blockers and push others to make deadlines.

Populate and maintain internal tools (for example Airtable, content calendars and trackers) with accurate client data, improving structures over time and raising any discrepancies early.

Communicate directly with clients on ideas and assets : present concepts, gather feedback, and adjust work without losing creative strength.

Create social-first content yourself : writing copy (captions, overlays, CTAs, post text) and producing simple visual assets (for example images with text or basic layouts) ready for publishing.

Run quality assurance checks on all assets before delivery, catching errors, off-brand details or non-compliance with specs and platform requirements.

Line manage a small team (around 3–5 people) : set priorities, delegate work, give clear feedback and support their development in both craft and process.

Be an expert in social platforms, trends and Storm Ideas products, using that knowledge to suggest smart strategies and content approaches that engage audiences and achieve client goals.

Use AI tools and LLMs to support your own creativity and efficiency, and spot opportunities to plug our AI systems into workflows (for example tagging, first-draft copy or asset variations), working with the wider team to trial and embed improvements.

Manage and grow your direct reports. Hold regular 1 : 1s, set goals, give honest feedback and make sure your team has the support, clarity and coaching they need to do their best work.

Application

Along with your CV, please send us a cover letter that tells us why you’re the perfect fit for this role, PLUS, make us a meme! Try your best to make us laugh with a simple text-on-image meme using TV or Film IP. We’d also LOVE if you could let us know your current favourite social media trend and why!

RECRUITMENT PROCESS

Initial Video Questions

If shortlisted, you’ll be invited to complete a short set of questions via our online video platform.

First Interview

You’ll then have an interview with a member of our recruitment team to discuss your experience, skills, and interest in the role.

Creative Task (if applicable)

We may ask you to prepare a few creative ideas or examples of your work ahead of the next stage.

Final Interview

The final stage will be an interview with Louise Sables, our CEO and Nina Bicket, Head of Content Production. This is your opportunity to talk in more depth about your creative approach and how you could contribute to our team.

Not sure if you tick every box? Apply anyway — we value potential, mindset, and ambition as much as experience.

title: FF&E Supply chain Manager
description:
This position will work closely with Interior Designers and Senior FF&E Procurement Manager to maintain FF&E budgets, project procurement, supply chain, logistics and project installations.

We are seeking a highly organized and experienced FF&E Supply Chain Project Manager to oversee the full logistics, quality control, and delivery process for a luxury residential hospitality project in Brazil. This role is responsible for managing production follow-up, factory coordination, inbound logistics from multiple regions (Brazil and Europe), storage operations in Preá, and final‑mile delivery into Jericoacoara—an area with challenging access conditions.

The ideal candidate has strong project management skills, experience in complex supply‑chain environments, and the ability to work collaboratively with vendors, factories, construction teams, installers, and logistics partners.

At a Glance:

  1. Mid–Senior role overseeing end‑to‑end FF&E supply chain for a luxury hospitality project in Brazil
  2. Responsible for factory supervision, quality control, and production sign‑off (Brazil & Europe)
  3. Manages storage operations in Preá and all inbound logistics
  4. Coordinates last‑mile delivery into Jericoacoara with specialized 4x4/off‑road vehicles
  5. Oversees inventory accuracy, documentation, dispatch & receiving
  6. Plans and supervises loading/unloading, equipment rental, and batch delivery scheduling
  7. Works closely with Construction for delivery timelines, site readiness, and installation planning
  8. Supervises Utopia‑hired installers to ensure deadlines, quality standards, and contractual commitments
  9. Must be highly organized, proactive, and experienced in complex or remote logistics environments

Responsibilities

Production Oversight & Quality Control

  • Supervise FF&E production at each factory (Brazil & Europe).
  • Conduct detailed quality checks and approve inventory before packing and sign‑off.
  • Ensure all items meet Utopia’s standards for quality, specifications, and finishes.

Inbound Logistics & Storage Management

  • Monitor and confirm the arrival of goods at the Preá storage facility.
  • Arrange and oversee loading/unloading operations at all locations.
  • Hire necessary local equipment or machinery as required.
  • Maintain a full, accurate, and continuously updated inventory of all items.

Documentation & Compliance

  • Handle all dispatch, receiving, and transport paperwork.
  • Ensure complete documentation for internal controls and auditing.

Delivery Coordination & Final‑Mile Logistics

  • Oversee delivery schedules from factories to Preá, ensuring timely arrivals.
  • Plan and manage logistics from Preá to Jericoacoara—including batch deliveries due to access restrictions (large trucks cannot cross dunes).
  • Hire and coordinate appropriate 4x4 or off‑road trucks capable of operating in sandy conditions.
  • Supervise all loading/unloading operations for the Preá–Jericoacoara transfers.

On‑Site Coordination & Installation Support

  • Coordinate delivery timelines and equipment needs with the Construction team.
  • Organize and supervise unpacking activities.
  • Oversee Utopia‑hired installation teams to ensure full compliance with contract requirements, deadlines, and quality standards.

Professional Experience

  • 5+ years of experience in FF&E logistics, supply chain management, project management, or procurement—preferably in hospitality or high‑end residential projects.
  • Proven experience supervising factory production, performing quality checks, and managing sign‑off processes.
  • Demonstrated ability to coordinate international and domestic logistics (Brazil + Europe preferred).
  • Experience managing storage facilities, inventory systems, and warehouse operations.
  • Solid track record overseeing loading/unloading operations, equipment rental, and transport coordination.
  • Hands‑on experience with remote or difficult‑access job sites (desert, beach, island, jungle environments are a strong plus).
  • Experience coordinating with construction teams, installers, and multiple vendors simultaneously.
  • Prior responsibility for delivery scheduling, documentation, and compliance.
  • Experience supervising installation teams is highly desirable.
  • Portuguese and English a must - any other language a plus.

Technical Skills

  • Strong knowledge of FF&E manufacturing processes, materials, finishes, and quality standards.
  • Proficiency in inventory management tools, tracking systems, and documentation workflows.
  • Understanding of logistics planning, especially final‑mile or off‑road delivery constraints.
  • Familiarity with transport regulations, customs basics, and dispatch/receiving procedures.
  • Strong reporting and documentation skills (photos, checklists, receiving logs, QC reports).
  • Ability to read technical documents (spec sheets, shop drawings, BOQs).

Salary and benefits are competitive and based on candidate experience.

description:
Job description

Desde dezembro de 2015, a SPDM/PAIS é responsável, em parceria com a Secretaria Municipal de Saúde do Rio de Janeiro, pelo gerenciamento do Hospital Municipal Pedro II .

A infraestrutura do Hospital conta com dez andares, nos quais estão distribuídos os serviços de emergência e de Unidade de Tratamento Intensivo (UTI) adulta, pediátrica e neonatal; maternidade; clínica médica, cirurgia-geral e bucomaxilofacial, neurocirurgia, psiquiatria, pediatria e ortopedia. Exames de imagem (raio X, tomografia, ultrassonografia, eletrocardiografia, ecocardiografia) e laboratoriais também são realizados na unidade.

Devido à grande população de idosos da Zona Oeste, região assistida pelo Hospital Municipal Pedro II (HMPII), há duas Enfermarias destinadas ao atendimento desse público.

O Centro de Tratamento de Queimados é outro diferencial entre os serviços oferecidos, e que dispõe de uma UTI exclusiva para prevenir infecções, que podem ser muito graves para quem está com queimaduras.

Além disso, a unidade conta com a Coordenação de Emergência Regional (CER) Santa Cruz, que possui 39 leitos, e tem como objetivo absorver as demandas de menor complexidade, deixando o HMPII liberado para os casos de risco iminente de morte, necessidade de cirurgia urgente e/ou internação. Um diferencial deste CER é o fato de possuir atendimento especializado em Psiquiatria e Obstetrícia.

Main responsibilities

Executar atividades de nutrição revisando os cardápios e dietas dos pacientes, bem como adequando o teor nutricional dos alimentos a fim de assegurar o atendimento das prescrições médicas.

Requirements and skills

  • Ensino Superior Completo em Nutrição
  • Especialização completa em uma ou mais das áreas citadas a seguir: Nutrição em Pediatria, Nutrição em Materno Infantil, Nutrição Clínica, Nutrição Geriatria e Gerontologia, Nutrição em Fitoterapia Nutricional ou Residência Multiprofissional em Saúde
  • Registro Ativo no Conselho da Classe

title: Senior Data Engineer
description:
At Hostelworld (Permanent), in Porto, Portugal

Expires at:

Remote policy: Full remote

WHO YOU'LL WORK WITH

You will play a key role in a diverse, highly-talented team managing cloud-native data engineering systems to consistently ensure the timely, accurate and secure production and delivery of data from the Hostelworld platform.

You will work closely with other technology groups and business owners to refine quality standards and processes for Data processing design, pipeline design, development and deployment. The underlying purpose is to ensure we have an efficient, robust, secure and performant data service to support our business growth.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

We’re seeking a Senior Data Engineer to lead the integration and modernization of a recently acquired company’s data ecosystem. You’ll collaborate closely with our new colleagues to learn, document, and understand their existing data product — currently based on Python and Airtable — and work to evolve it into our modern Google Cloud Platform (GCP) stack.

This is a hands‑on, strategic role that combines architecture, delivery excellence, and collaboration. You’ll bring strong software engineering discipline to our data workflows, ensuring all pipelines are built with testability, version control, and CI/CD best practices in mind.

Bridge and Modernize Systems

  • Learn and document the acquired company’s current data ecosystem, including Airtable structures, Python scripts, and API integrations.
  • Translate that understanding into clear technical documentation and communicate findings back to our internal data and engineering teams.
  • Design and lead a modernization roadmap to integrate their systems into our GCP‑based medallion architecture.
  • Champion pragmatic migration strategies that balance business continuity with long‑term scalability.

Design and Deliver Robust Data Pipelines

  • Build, orchestrate, and maintain scalable ELT pipelines using Astro (Airflow), DBT, and BigQuery.
  • Ingest data from APIs and third‑party systems into our unified data model.
  • Embed data validation, testing, and observability into every stage of the pipeline.

Apply Engineering Best Practices

  • Drive excellence in the software development lifecycle (SDLC) — from design and peer review to automated testing, deployment, and monitoring.
  • Implement and improve CI/CD pipelines for data workflows (e.g., Astro Cloud, GitHub Actions, Terraform).
  • Promote a “data‑as‑code” mindset, ensuring reproducibility, versioning, and auditability across environments.

Collaborate and Lead in an Agile Environment

  • Act as a senior contributor in the teams Scrum ceremonies (planning, review, retrospectives), driving transparency and continuous improvement.
  • Communicate findings, technical designs, and migration recommendations clearly and proactively to internal stakeholders.
  • Partner with global data and software teams to align on design standards, delivery milestones, and business priorities.

WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR

5+ years of experience in data engineering, designing, building, and maintaining robust, cloud‑native data pipelines.

3+ years of experience as a Python developer, developing data processing scripts, automation, and API integrations.

2+ years of experience in Google Cloud Platform (GCP), including deploying and managing scalable ETL/ELT pipelines.

  • Proven track record with orchestration and transformation tools, including Astro (Airflow) and DBT.
  • Strong understanding of data quality, testing, and observability frameworks (e.g., Great Expectations, dbt tests).
  • Experience implementing CI/CD pipelines for data workflows using tools such as GitHub Actions, Terraform, and Astro Cloud.
  • Familiarity with Agile and Scrum practices, with experience collaborating in cross‑functional teams and leading technical discussions.
  • Demonstrated ability to learn, document, and modernize legacy data systems while communicating technical findings clearly to internal stakeholders.

Nice to have

  • Experience working with Airtable and integrating its API into larger data systems
  • Hands‑on experience with BigQuery for data storage, analytics, and transformation.

WHAT WE OFFER

  • Competitive salary & benefits
  • Enhanced annual leave plus 3 Wellbeing Days per year
  • Paid family leave (maternity, paternity, surrogacy & adoption)
  • Agile working (plus a Working from Abroad Policy!)
  • Support for your ongoing growth & development
  • Inclusive people policies (sickness, menopause, compassionate and fertility leave)
  • A chance to give back to your local community with 5 paid volunteering days

OUR BEHAVIOURS

Grow others - We fundamentally believe that investing in growing others benefits everyone, whether it’s helping them develop hard or soft skills. We want learning and growing to be part of our DNA to help makes us a better team, together.

Master it - We are obsessed with our area of expertise and enjoy developing our skills. We rarely take things at face value; we investigate, interrogate, and always look for ‘the why,’ and wherever possible, we use data to find the best solution.

Collaborate - We are in it together, for the tough stuff and the celebrations too. To achieve the best results, we need expertise from all areas of the organisation, and we wholeheartedly welcome diverse thinking.

Adapt - We work fluidly, adapting to new information and the evolving environment while staying committed to our goals. Innovation and experimentation fuel our projects and we’re never afraid to pivot.

Deliver - Our focus is always on the end result; we value outcomes over activity. We collaborate to deliver work at speed without dropping any of our other behaviours.

We believe in talented and diverse teams that reflect the diversity of our customers and the communities in which we operate. Everyone brings different perspectives and experiences. We lay out the above requirements to guide applicants to the experiences that we believe will allow you to be successful in the role. If you don’t meet them all, please consider applying if you think you can still perform the role as described.

About LILT

AI is changing how the world communicates — and LILT is leading that transformation.

We're on a mission to make the world's information accessible to everyone , regardless of the language they speak. We use cutting-edge AI, machine translation, and human-in-the-loop expertise to translate content faster, more accurately, and more cost-effectively without compromising on brand, voice, or quality.

At LILT, we empower our teammates with leading tools, global collaboration, and growth opportunities to do their best work. Our company virtues—Work together, win together; Find a way or make one; Quicker than they expect; Quality is Job 1 —guide everything we do. We are trusted by Intel Corporation, Canva, the United States Department of Defense, the United States Air Force, ASICS, and hundreds of global Enterprises. Backed by Sequoia, Intel Capital, and Redpoint, we’re building a category-defining company in a $50B+ global translation market being redefined by AI.

Are you passionate about AI and skilled at analyzing both text and multimedia content?

We’re looking for detail-oriented linguists with native speaker fluency in Brazilian Portuguese to support in AI-training related projects, including tasks such as prompt evaluation, video content understanding, text review & correction , and more.

This is a remote, freelance opportunity .

Who we're looking for

  • Native speaker fluency only
  • Strong command of English
  • Experience as a reviewer, annotator, or evaluator preferred
  • High attention to detail and ability to thoroughly and accurately categorize content
  • Comfortable working with both textual and audio/video materials
  • Ability to follow detailed guidelines consistently and provide clear feedback

What we offer

  • Free access to our leading-edge NMT technology, with full training and support
  • Rapid payments via Tipalti — no invoicing needed
  • Opportunity to contribute to cutting-edge developments in AI and content understanding

If you’re interested, please submit an updated version of your resume in English.

Our Story

Our founders, Spence and John met at Google working on Google Translate. As researchers at Stanford and Berkeley, they both worked on language technology to make information accessible to everyone. While together at Google, they were amazed to learn that Google Translate wasn’t used for enterprise products and services inside the company. The quality just wasn’t there. So they set out to build something better. LILT was born.

LILT has been a machine learning company since its founding in 2015. At the time, machine translation didn’t meet the quality standard for enterprise translations, so LILT assembled a cutting-edge research team tasked with closing that gap. While meeting customer demand for translation services, LILT has prioritized investments in Large Language Models, human-in-the-loop systems, and now agentic AI.

With AI innovation accelerating and enterprise demand growing, the next phase of LILT’s journey is just beginning.

Our Tech

What sets our platform apart:

  • Brand-aware AI that learns your voice, tone, and terminology to ensure every translation is accurate and consistent
  • Agentic AI workflows that automate the entire translation process from content ingestion to quality review to publishing
  • 100+ native integrations with systems like Adobe Experience Manager, Webflow, Salesforce, GitHub, and Google Drive to simplify content translation
  • Human-in-the-loop reviews via our global network of professional linguists, for high-impact content that requires expert review

LILT in the News

  • Featured in The Software Report’s Top 100 Software Companies!
  • LILT makes it onto the Inc. 5000 List.
  • LILT’s continues to be an intellectual powerhouse, holding numerous patents that help power the most efficient and sophisticated AI and language models in the industry.

title: Delivery Operations Analyst
description:
The Company You’ll Join

Carta is a platform that helps people manage equity, build businesses, and invest in the companies of tomorrow. Our mission is to unlock the power of equity ownership for more people in more places.

Carta is trusted by more than 40,000 companies and over two million people in nearly 160 countries to manage cap tables, compensation, and valuations. Carta also supports nearly 7,000 funds and SPVs, and represents nearly $130B in assets under administration. Carta’s tender offer solutions have returned $14B to shareholders in secondary transactions. Today, Carta’s platform manages nearly three trillion dollars in equity globally.

The Problems You'll Solve

At Carta, our employees set out on a mission to unlock the power of equity ownership for more people in more places. We believe that the problems we solve today unlock the opportunities of tomorrow.

The role involves tasks like analyzing business operations and identifying customer needs in order to bring the two closer together. They should maintain a high attention to detail, strong quantitative analysis, and have the ability to juggle multiple competing priorities across a variety of audiences (from IC’s to senior / exec level staff).

  • Analytical Excellence
  • Ability to track and analyze reports and data queries
  • Identify customer needs and align processes with the customer journey
  • Develop operational improvement plans informed by data
  • Skills with the use of Google Drive Suite, such as Word and Excel
  • Leverage strong quantitative and analytical skills to address specific data requests and find correlations from analysis
  • Experience with advanced computer systems and BI analytics systems, such as Looker, Salesforce, HTML and maintains some knowledge of content management systems
  • Ability to tell the story of the customer journey through a growing level of business acumen and, ultimately, learning how to improve the lives of both internal and external stakeholders
  • Manage quality, costs and the efficiency of the organization
  • Reengineer and streamline processes to improve efficiency, leverage and productivity
  • Train Client Services operations staff
  • Conduct operational research
  • Solves complex problems relating to the operation of the Client Services
  • Stays up-to-date on software that is commonly used in the industry
  • Drive Operational Excellence “Think Big Picture”
  • Analyze how information is recorded and how the process can be improved
  • Analyze customer needs and determine how operations can be altered to improve service to customers and better meet their needs
  • Work to increase the value of a business
  • Oversee quality control and recommend process improvements for everyday operating procedures
  • Promote a smooth delivery system for products and services to clients
  • Be able to create and drive an Implementation Plan or Business Plan

The Team You'll Work With

We are looking for a Delivery Operations Analyst to join our GTM Operations Department. The Operations Analyst will be responsible for owning and driving tasks that overall benefit the delivery organization. Their primary objective is to assist the teams they partner with to leverage process improvement, analytical excellence, and tools implementation to better drive a more efficient cost-to-serve model.

About You

  • Problem solving and investigative skills – proactive approach that ends up solving high-leverage problems
  • People skills – willing and able to speak confidently to senior leadership about key process improvement opportunities
  • Self-motivated and dependable
  • Project management skills / ability to meet deadlines – meet performance and schedule timelines on key initiatives / operational tasks
  • Adaptable and proactive – displays “can do” winning approach to every operational encounter
  • Consistency, accuracy and prowess to execution – maniacal focus on excellence and integrity
  • Leadership capabilities – ability to cross-functionally communicate with leadership
  • Multitasking – able to swiftly move through projects with perseverance and poise

Important Security Notice for Candidates

Our company has been targeted by individuals creating fake domains similar to ours to scam prospects and candidates. Please note that all official communications from us will come from an @carta.com domain. Be cautious of any requests for sensitive information or payments outside of our official channels. For more information about this type of scam, please review information provided by the Federal Trade Commission (FTC). If you encounter any suspicious activity, please report it immediately.

About the Role

We've partnered with a growing early childhood education provider that operates a nationwide network of child care centers. They are hiring a Senior Accountant to oversee end-to-end accounting operations across 20–30 centers and lead the transition from QuickBooks Online to NetSuite.

This is a high-impact role where you'll combine hands‑on accounting with process improvement, helping the organization scale as it continues to expand its footprint.

What You'll Do

  • Lead and support the transition from QuickBooks Online to NetSuite (~70% complete), ensuring accuracy, compliance, and efficiency

  • Prepare and analyze financial statements, reports, and supporting schedules
  • Maintain and update loan schedules, insurance allocations, and related entries across operating entities
  • Categorize transactions in Ramp, Brex, and other systems (~1 day / month)
  • Provide financial insights and recommendations to management for decision‑making
  • Continuously improve accounting processes and leverage NetSuite functionality for efficiency gains
  • Handle other responsibilities typically expected of a Senior Accountant

What We're Looking For

  • CPA or equivalent preferred
  • 5+ years of progressive, hands‑on accounting experience
  • Strong knowledge of U.S. GAAP and financial reporting standards

Proficiency in NetSuite

Familiarity with QuickBooks Online and transition projects from QBO to NetSuite preferred.

  • Excellent organizational, time management, and communication skills
  • Ability to operate independently while supporting a multi‑entity, growing organization

Why Join Through MAVI?

  • 100% Remote
  • High-impact role supporting a fast-growing education services company
  • Competitive compensation aligned with global opportunities
  • Build your track record within the MAVI network

Selection Process

title: Especialista Fiscal
description:
Sobre a Flowa

A Flowa Technologies é uma empresa de tecnologia especializada em mercado financeiro e pioneira no segmento de Electronic Trading. Desenvolvemos soluções tecnológicas robustas e eficientes voltadas para a negociação eletrônica de ativos financeiros nas principais bolsas das Américas.

Movidos por tecnologia e inovação, sede de aprendizado contínuo e vontade de fazer a diferença, somos um time comprometido e apaixonado pelo que fazemos.

Estamos atualmente envolvidos em um projeto único: a criação de uma nova bolsa de valores para o Brasil. Por meio de uma infraestrutura de ponta, a Base Exchange visa ampliar o mercado de capitais do país, trazendo mais uma opção para que empresas e investidores façam seus negócios com transparência, agilidade e tecnologia.

Junto com a nossa evolução, crescem os desafios e buscamos profissionais com iniciativa, motivados e com disposição para aprender.

No seu dia a dia, você irá atuar com:

  • Liderar a transição de parte da área fiscal, atualmente terceirizada, estruturando processos, políticas, controles internos e calendário fiscal em alinhamento com os objetivos estratégicos do negócio;
  • Apoiar as decisões estratégicas por meio da análise de regimes tributários, revisão de contratos sob a ótica fiscal e identificação de oportunidades de eficiência;
  • Acompanhar mudanças na legislação e propor medidas de adaptação à operação, preparando a Companhia para os impactos da reforma tributária e sugerindo ações corretivas e/ou de adequação;
  • Atuar na execução direta e/ou revisão de tributos diretos e indiretos, assegurando a conformidade das obrigações fiscais;
  • Implementar governança fiscal e controles sobre os processos tributários, apoiando a parametrização de ERP e assegurando a integridade das informações;
  • Monitorar os passivos tributários da Companhia, elaborando relatórios de exposição e evolução para a gestão;
  • Ser o ponto focal da área fiscal junto a consultorias, auditores independentes, autoridades fiscais e contabilidade terceirizada;
  • Promover conscientização tributária entre as áreas internas, conduzindo treinamentos e orientações sobre boas práticas fiscais;
  • Atuar de forma estratégica, mas também prática e operacional, sendo referência técnica na implantação e sustentação da área fiscal.

O que você precisa:

  • Ensino superior completo em Ciências Contábeis, Direito, Administração, Economia ou áreas correlatas;
  • Experiência sólida em rotinas fiscais, incluindo execução e revisão de apurações e obrigações acessórias;
  • Vivência com implantação de processos, controles e parametrização de sistemas / ERP;
  • Conhecimento da legislação tributária brasileira e de diferentes regimes de apuração;
  • Excel intermediário;
  • Inglês intermediário para leitura e escrita de documentos financeiros;
  • Perfil proativo, autônomo e com capacidade de estruturar processos em um ambiente de transformação, interagindo com múltiplas áreas.

A Flowa é movimento, crescimento e evolução. Aqui você encontrará um ambiente dinâmico e colaborativo, onde todos são protagonistas. Se você busca uma oportunidade de crescimento e quer fazer parte de uma equipe engajada no propósito de transformar o mercado de electronic trading, vem com a gente!

#FlowaTechnologies: nossos valores são humanos.

title: Página da Vaga | Analista de Custos Pleno
description:
Somos a PRIO, a maior companhia independente de óleo e gás do Brasil. Buscamos continuamente por otimização de processos operacionais e de soluções inovadoras que visem diminuir os custos. Aqui todo trabalho é multidisciplinar e cada desafio é único!

Estamos em busca de um(a) Analista de Custos Pleno para atuar de forma estratégica na gestão dos custos logísticos da companhia. Essa posição será responsável por garantir visibilidade, precisão, eficiência e governança sobre todos os gastos relacionados à área de Logística.

Responsabilidade principal da vaga

  • Controlar, analisar e consolidar os custos logísticos (OPEX e CAPEX) de ponta a ponta , abrangendo transporte marítimo, transporte aéreo, logística de pessoas, combustíveis, bases operacionais, operações de apoio e logística terrestre.

Demais responsabilidades

  • Acompanhar custos e performance das operações logísticas, garantindo aderência a contratos, premissas orçamentárias e padrões regulatórios.
  • Planejar e controlar a demanda de serviços logísticos, alinhando necessidades operacionais com fornecedores e requisitos internos.
  • Apoiar a construção e revisão do orçamento logístico, com análise crítica de variações e premissas.
  • Atuar em projetos de tecnologia aplicados à logística, como implantação ou melhoria de sistemas de gestão, planejamento e rastreamento.
  • Desenvolver análises e iniciativas de redução de custos, buscando alternativas de mercado, otimização operacional e melhoria contínua.

Formação acadêmica (graduação se necessário ou curso técnico)

  • Formação Superior Completa

Experiência prévia desejada e/ou mandatória

  • Experiência com análise e controle de custos, preferencialmente em logística.
  • Inglês intermediário é diferencial.
  • Conhecimento de SAP e Power BI avançado.

Como é o processo seletivo na PRIO?

Gostamos de já chegar na entrevista te conhecendo um pouco, então pedimos a você que preencha ainda na etapa de cadastro alguns testes para podermos avaliar o seu Match com a nossa Cultura :)

Depois, nós do time de RH vamos marcar um papo com você. A ideia aqui é aprofundar um pouco mais nas suas experiências, buscando o alinhamento com o perfil da vaga e comportamental que buscamos para a PRIO. Ah, nesse papo também vamos falar sobre a companhia, fluxo do processo, benefícios e tirar suas dúvidas!

Dica: Nesse nosso papo, vamos querer saber sobre experiências que você já vivenciou, alinhadas aos valores da PRIO. A ideia é que você consiga nos apresentar essas vivências de forma completa, com contextos, sua responsabilidade, o que você fez e qual foi o resultado!

Em seguida, vamos adentrando em aspectos mais técnicos, que podem envolver um case ou apenas uma entrevista com o(a) gestor(a) da vaga, aonde você poderá conhecer um pouco mais sobre os desafios técnicos da vaga e será avaliado dentro dos requisitos da vaga.

Ao fim, os finalistas conversam com o diretor da respectiva área para a escolha final!

Como se preparar para o processo seletivo na PRIO:

-Pesquise sobre o negócio da companhia e nossa atuação no setor de óleo e gás;

>-Busque se atualizar sobre as notícias recentes da companhia, sejam da imprensa ou divulgadas em nosso site de relações com investidores;

-Acesse nossas redes sociais para conhecer mais sobre como é trabalhar na PRIO!

-Pense na sua história e principais realizações. Estruture seus resultados e conquistas para relatá-los na hora da entrevista.

Fale dos sucessos, mas entender as falhas e como você aprendeu com elas também é importante. Prezamos pela transparência, por isso, não tenha medo de falar sobre os seus insucessos.

Desejamos a você um bom processo seletivo!

Venha fazer parte da PRIO

Somos a PRIO, a maior companhia independente de óleo e gás do Brasil. Buscamos continuamente por otimização de processos operacionais e de soluções inovadoras que visem diminuir os custos. Aqui todo trabalho é multidisciplinar e cada desafio é único!

Com foco no investimento e na recuperação de ativos em produção, somos especializados na gestão eficiente de reservatórios e no redesenvolvimento de campos maduros. Acreditamos na condução dos negócios, com foco em segurança e cuidado com a saúde dos seus colaboradores.

Nosso ambiente de trabalho

Oferecemos um ambiente de trabalho dinâmico e com muitas oportunidades de participação em diferentes projetos, favorecendo o desenvolvimento profissional e o crescimento do time. Trabalhamos em um escritório open space, o que permite a integração entre todas as equipes e a Diretoria, onde todos podem participar da tomada de decisões.

Nossa cultura busca o alto desempenho e a participação efetiva de todas as pessoas. Se você sonha em se desenvolver junto com uma empresa em constante crescimento, venha fazer parte do nosso time!
